title: Allow empty key_actions for short dialogue/emotion/info scenes; fix canary chapter selection

old_behavior.key_actions: strict_contract required len(key_actions)>=1 with evidence; empty array failed with BUSINESS_VALIDATION_ERROR
old_behavior.normalization: single-paragraph empty key_actions fabricated from goal/outcome
old_behavior.prompt_v3.1: key_actions至少一项、允许多项且每项有Evidence
old_behavior.canary_import: stamped chapter_title caused front-matter split; runner selected metadata-only first chapter

new_behavior.key_actions: empty array legal when no clear action; non-empty items each require summary + in-scene evidence
new_behavior.normalization: evidence ID cleanup only; never fabricate key_actions
new_behavior.prompt_v3.2: documents empty key_actions for dialogue/emotion/info; repair forbids inventing actions
new_behavior.canary_import: stamp matches offline (no title heading); select narrative chapter; abort if metadata-thin

compatibility_impact: Scene analysis responses with key_actions=[] now succeed when other required fields are evidenced; unevidenced non-empty actions still fail. Active prompt version becomes v3.2; v3.1 files unchanged.
rollback_plan: Point boundary_review_service and provider_eligibility back to scene_analysis v3.1; restore previous validate_scene_analysis/normalize bodies from git; revert core-freeze-manifest hashes for those three service files; leave v3.2 prompt directory unused.

core_freeze_update.note: v3.1 entries retained as historical frozen artifacts; active version bumped via this change package
